headlines.title: Five Palestinians killed, including four women, in Israeli strike in western Gaza - وكالة الأنباء السورية – سانا
headlines.snippet: Five Palestinians, including four women, were killed in an Israeli strike in western Gaza, according to the Syrian Arab News Agency (SANA).

headlines.title: Somalia condemns Houthi attack on Madinah power station - وكالة الأنباء السورية – سانا
headlines.snippet: Somalia has condemned a Houthi attack on the Madinah power station, according to SANA.

headlines.title: Israeli explosions rock al-Mansouri as shelling hits towns in southern Lebanon - وكالة الأنباء السورية – سانا
headlines.snippet: Israeli explosions were heard in al-Mansouri, and shelling targeted towns in southern Lebanon, according to SANA.

headlines.title: IEA says 325 million barrels released from emergency oil stocks since March - وكالة الأنباء السورية – سانا
headlines.snippet: The IEA stated that 325 million barrels have been released from emergency oil stocks since March, according to SANA.

headlines.title: Israeli occupation forces shell outskirts of Abidin in Daraa, southern Syria - وكالة الأنباء السورية – سانا
headlines.snippet: Israeli occupation forces shelled the outskirts of Abidin in Daraa, southern Syria, according to SANA.

headlines.title: Syria’s Muslim Brotherhood fights for its future
headlines.snippet: Syria's Muslim Brotherhood is grappling with its future amid regional pressure and internal divisions, facing questions about political parties and pluralism.

headlines.title: Syria is rising, al-Sharaa tells UN—but challenges remain at home
headlines.snippet: Syria's representative stated at the UN that Syria is rising, but domestic challenges remain. The country faces the task of converting international acceptance into economic progress and stronger institutions.

headlines.title: UAE says FlyDubai co-pilot attempted to carry out terrorist attack
headlines.snippet: The UAE has stated that the Flydubai co-pilot attempted to carry out a terrorist act, as reported by Arab News.

headlines.title: Gargash says FlyDubai attack ‘terrorist act’ as he praises pilot
headlines.snippet: Gargash stated that the Flydubai attack was a "terrorist act" and praised the pilot, as reported by Arab News.

headlines.title: Two Iranians charged with planning attack on Manchester Jews
headlines.snippet: Two Iranians have been charged with planning an attack on Jews in Manchester, as reported by Arab News.

headlines.title: Netanyahu warns ‘very heavy price’ if any power behind FlyDubai incident
headlines.snippet: Netanyahu warned of a "very heavy price" if any power is found behind the Flydubai incident, as reported by Arab News.

headlines.title: Gaza journalist killed in Israeli drone strike
headlines.snippet: A Gaza journalist was killed in an Israeli drone strike, as reported by Arab News.

headlines.title: UAE says flydubai co-pilot attempted ‘terrorist act’ on Israel-bound flight
headlines.snippet: The UAE stated that the flydubai co-pilot attempted a "terrorist act" on an Israel-bound flight, as reported by Gulf News.

headlines.title: Who is Captain Smit Machchhar? Dubai-based flydubai pilot hailed as hero after cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Captain Smit Machchhar, a Dubai-based flydubai pilot, is being hailed as a hero after an attack in the cockpit, as reported by Gulf News.

headlines.title: PM Modi speaks to flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar after mid-air cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Prime Minister Modi spoke with flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar following the mid-air cockpit attack, as reported by Gulf News.

headlines.title: Benjamin Netanyahu invites flydubai pilot who averted mid-air crisis to Israel
headlines.snippet: Benjamin Netanyahu has invited the flydubai pilot who averted a mid-air crisis to visit Israel, as reported by Gulf News.

headlines.title: Oil tankers attacked in Hormuz strait: UK maritime agency
headlines.snippet: Oil tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the UK maritime agency via Gulf News.

headlines.title: Iraq’s Najaf airport to resume flights with Iran on Sunday
headlines.snippet: Iraq’s Najaf airport is set to resume flights with Iran on Sunday. Initially, three evening flights are scheduled, allowing up to 40 daily flights excluding Mahan Air.

headlines.title: Royal Air Maroc denies employing co-pilot accused in Flydubai cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Royal Air Maroc has denied employing the co-pilot accused in the Flydubai cockpit incident, stating a job application was rejected.

headlines.title: 260 Houthis killed in 97 operations on southern fronts: Yemeni army
headlines.snippet: The Yemeni army reported that 260 Houthis were killed in 97 operations on southern fronts. They also claim 44 vehicles and supply assets were destroyed or damaged.

headlines.title: Russia again urges foreign diplomats to leave Kyiv
headlines.snippet: Russia has again urged foreign diplomats to leave Kyiv, citing potential "large-scale retaliatory strikes."

headlines.title: Tennessee prison chief resigns after failed Christa Pike execution
headlines.snippet: Frank Strada has resigned as Tennessee prison chief following a failed execution attempt. An independent review into the botched lethal injection is underway.

headlines.title: Erdoğan vows action over Soma mine collapse at TEKNOFEST
headlines.snippet: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan vowed accountability for those responsible for a deadly mine collapse in Manisa. An investigation is ongoing.

headlines.title: Chinese robot wows crowds with Turkish 'halay' dance at Teknofest
headlines.snippet: A Chinese robot impressed crowds at Teknofest Southeast by performing a traditional Turkish "halay" dance.

headlines.title: King Charles to confront Britain’s slavery past during Caribbean tour
headlines.snippet: King Charles is expected to confront Britain's past involvement in slavery during a Caribbean tour, amid calls for Britain to address its history.

headlines.title: Egypt's Sisi calls for peaceful solutions to Africa’s conflicts
headlines.snippet: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi urged African countries to prioritize peaceful conflict resolution and strengthen state institutions.

headlines.title: Philippines urges ASEAN talks after 50 killed in Myanmar airstrike
headlines.snippet: The Philippines, holding the ASEAN chairmanship in 2026, expressed concern over a deadly airstrike in Myanmar's Rakhine state and offered mediation.

headlines.title: PHOTO Best restaurants in Istanbul, ranked
headlines.snippet: The Hürriyet newspaper's "Pearly Gastronomy Guide" ranks the best restaurants in Istanbul based on expert opinions.
headlines.title_he: תמונה: המסעדות הטובות ביותר באיסטנבול, מדורגות
headlines.snippet_he: חבר המומחים של עיתון Hürriyet יצר את "מדריך הגסטרונומיה הפנינית" כדי לדרג את המסעדות הטובות ביותר בטורקיה, כולל 20 הטובות ביותר באיסטנבול.

headlines.title: Top 29 must-try Turkish street foods Türkiye is frequently described as a paradise when it comes to cuisine.
headlines.snippet: Turkey offers numerous street food options, from "wet" hamburgers to roasted chestnuts, selected by a gastronomy jury.
headlines.title_he: 29 מאכלי הרחוב הטורקיים שחובה לטעום – טורקיה מתוארת לעיתים קרובות כגן עדן בכל הנוגע למטבח.
headlines.snippet_he: רשימה מציגה 29 מאכלי רחוב טורקיים שחובה לנסות, שנבחרו על ידי חבר שופטים בתחום הגסטרונומיה.

headlines.title: Top 20 museums in Türkiye As a historic home to great civilizations, Türkiye has some of the world’s best museums.
headlines.snippet: Türkiye, a historic home to civilizations like the Roman and Ottoman empires, boasts some of the world's best museums.
headlines.title_he: 20 המוזיאונים המובילים בטורקיה כבית היסטורי לציוויליזציות גדולות, לטורקיה יש כמה מהמוזיאונים הטובים בעולם.
headlines.snippet_he: טורקיה, בית היסטורי לציוויליזציות כמו האימפריה הרומית והעות'מאנית, מתהדרת בכמה מהמוזיאונים הטובים בעולם.

headlines.title: Best gifts and souvenirs to buy from Türkiye Best souvenirs to buy from 30 places in Türkiye.
headlines.snippet: This entry provides a guide to the best gifts and souvenirs to purchase from 30 locations in Türkiye.

headlines.title: FlyDubai co-pilot attacked captain with 'axe' in 'terrorist' attempt, UAE top prosecutor says
headlines.snippet: The UAE stated that the FlyDubai co-pilot attempted a "terrorist act" using an axe, according to TRT World.

headlines.title: Illegal Israeli settlers attack Palestinian olive harvesters in occupied West Bank
headlines.snippet: Illegal Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian olive harvesters in the occupied West Bank, as reported by TRT World.

headlines.title: Arab party leader agrees to drop out of Israeli election race under court pressure
headlines.snippet: An Arab party leader agreed to withdraw from the Israeli election race under court pressure, as reported by TRT World.

headlines.title: Morocco airline denies employing co-pilot in Flydubai cockpit incident
headlines.snippet: Morocco airline has denied employing the co-pilot involved in the Flydubai cockpit incident, as reported by TRT World.

headlines.title: Türkiye condemns Houthi strike on infrastructure serving Prophet's Mosque
headlines.snippet: Türkiye has condemned the Houthi strike on infrastructure serving the Prophet's Mosque, as reported by TRT World.
